contribution_types.description: PDT-98: track historical portfolio performance of subscribers who have linked their accounts
Facetime meeting to chat about engineering matters (Vishvajit and Gary) (30 minutes)

Raised key questions that will be asked by forthcoming investors

- I know I invested in some tokens last year. What I need to know is what is the near future valuation going to be so that I can decide for myself if I want to invest
    Response: Right now everyone is still investing at USD1. At fundraising in September and October, we will raised at USD4 

- Who controls the wallet. How is the person controlling the wallet determine
    Response: Right now me. In future the reserve tokens will be transferred to the Swiss CooP and the wallet will be controlled by multiple different signers that were elected

- What needs to be done and what do you need from me investment wise?
    Response: 1 frontend engineer that is familiar with Ruby on Rails and ReactJs

- Who else is working on the project
    Response: KratosLabs is working the blockchain and payment security layer. Pris head of AIA research, Edi from Silicon Valley, Shino art director of Nanyang Academy and Kuolon from Singapore is working on design

- Sounds like you have got a big team. How did you find all these people
    Response: I literally travelled the world

narrative.text: Vishvajit contributed to the DAO with four entries focused on the MarketMonocle project from October 2021 to July 2022. He attended FaceTime meetings for Build Game - Strategy every 30 minutes on one occasion and reviewed proposed strategies, suggesting against certain actions or areas to watch out for on another.
